audience: Developers and open-source maintainers who want responsible social publishing

evidence.claim: ReachWeaver contains a Claude Code skill and a local-first publishing CLI; live integrations are limited.

variants.angle: The engineering difference between drafting and publishing
variants.text:
A social post is also a production operation.

ReachWeaver is an open development project for Claude Code: brand-aware drafting, local approvals and a cautious publishing outbox. It does not pretend that every network is connected.

If you build developer tools, which publishing failure would you most want to prevent?

https://github.com/MSKazemi/reachweaver

Writing a post is easy. Proving it was approved, sent once, and measured correctly is harder. ReachWeaver explores that with a Claude Code skill and a local-first CLI: https://github.com/MSKazemi/reachweaver
variants.cta: Invite maintainers to review the design
